DDDevice.doc: An object that describes a discovered device of interest.

DDDeviceEvent.doc: An object that provides a device or communicates its change in status.

DDDiscoverySession.doc: An object that relays device discovery events from the extension to the system.

DDDeviceCategory.doc: An option that determines the icon for the device in the picker UI.

DDDeviceMediaPlaybackState.doc: States that indicate the status of a device’s media playback.

DDDeviceProtocol.doc: An identifier for the manner in which an app interacts with a device.

DDDeviceState.doc: A state that represents the level of user interaction with the device.

DDDeviceStateActivated.doc: A state that indicates when the user authorizes the device and the app connects to the device.

DDDeviceStateActivating.doc: A state that indicates when the user selects the device in the picker UI.

DDDeviceStateAuthorized.doc: A state that indicates when the user authorizes the device.

DDDeviceStateInvalid.doc: A state that indicates the device is invalid or that the user disapproves of the device.

DDDeviceStateInvalidating.doc: A state that indicates that the device is soon to be invalid.

DDDeviceSupportsBluetoothHID.doc: Device supports bring up of classic transport profiles when low energy transport for peripheral is connected.

DDErrorCode.doc: Codes that identify errors that can occur during the framework’s use.

DDEventType.doc: Identifiers for the types of events that occur in the device discovery life cycle.

-initWithDisplayName:category:protocolTy.doc: Creates an object that describes a discovered device.

-initWithEventType:device:.doc: Creates an event object that conveys status for a discovered device of interest.

-reportEvent:.doc: Reports an event to the system.

DDDeviceCategory.doc: An option that determines the icon for the device in the picker UI.

DDDeviceMediaPlaybackState.doc: States that indicate the status of a device’s media playback.

DDDeviceProtocol.doc: An identifier for the manner in which an app interacts with a device.

bluetoothIdentifier.doc: An identifier to communicate with the device through Bluetooth wireless technology.

category.doc: An option that determies the icon that the picker UI displays for the device.

displayName.doc: A name for the device to display to the user.

identifier.doc: A unique identifier for the device.

mediaContentSubtitle.doc: A subtitle for the current media that the device plays.

mediaContentTitle.doc: A title for the current media that the device plays.

mediaPlaybackState.doc: A playback status for the device’s current media.

networkEndpoint.doc: An object that describes a local-network device.

protocol.doc: The manner in which the system applies your app’s device discovery extension.

protocolType.doc: A custom universal type that describes the device’s manner of communication with the extension.

state.doc: A state that represents the level of user interaction with the device.

supportsGrouping.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether to group the device with others in the AirPlay UI.

txtRecord.doc: A dictionary of metadata for the device that the extension communicates with over the local network.

txtRecordData.doc: A dictionary of metadata for the device that the extension communicates with over the local network.

url.doc: A resource locator for the simple service discovery protocol.

wifiAwareServiceRole.doc: Device’s Wi-Fi Aware’s service. Default is DDDeviceWiFiAwareServiceRoleSubscriber

device.doc: An object that describes a third-party media receiver.
